note: The economics of the replenishment decision. Every value is a stylised choice of the example, not read from a pharmacy (docs/use-cases.md section 4.1).

z_milli.note: service target: the forecast plus 1.28 standard deviations (about 90 percent) where a standard deviation is sqrt(forecast), a Poisson-like noise assumed, not fitted

penalty_per_unit_short.note: cost of a unit short of the target

penalty_per_unit_short_critical.note: the same for an item whose absence costs more

waste_per_unit.note: cost of a unit held beyond what the shelf life can sell at the forecast rate (an expiry proxy: lots are not shown to the planner)

max_packs.note: packs of one item in one order

controlled_max_packs.note: packs of a controlled item in one order
